note: Dominica, read on the Invest Dominica Authority's Work & Residency Permit page (investdominica.com, the government's investment agency) and the Government of Dominica's 'How Do I Apply for a Residence Permit?' (dominica.gov.dm) on 2026-10-30. A non-national must first obtain a work permit from the Labour Division; it automatically confers residency where the employment lasts more than six months, is valid one year and renewable; the employer's letter accepts responsibility and offers employment for a year in the first instance (work for the sponsor); the application fee is EC$800 for non-CARICOM nationals (EC$250 for CARICOM; the non-CARICOM fee kept); an extension of stay is needed until the permit is approved, so it is read as applied for in Dominica. The residence permit is asked of the Immigration Department while on an extension of stay, on a banker's statement of the applicant's (or a sponsor's) finances, EC$800 for non-CARICOM nationals; it is read as a residence on means, with no work, work taking the permit above. OECS citizens' freedom to work and the CARICOM skills certificate are the work engine's, not read here. Decision times, terms of the residence permit, permanent residence and naturalisation's years aren't stated.

sources.title: Invest Dominica Authority, Work & Residency Permit
sources.said: Non Nationals wishing to engage in work in Dominica must first obtain a work permit from the Labour Division. ... A work permit automatically confers residency status if the term of employment lasts for more than six months. All work permits are valid for one-year duration and can be renewed. ... offer of employment for one year in the first instance ... Application fee: EC$800.00 US$295.00 (Non-CARICOM Members) OR EC$250.00 US$93.00 (CARCOM) ... Extension of stay is required until permit is approved

sources.title: Government of Dominica, How Do I Apply for a Residence Permit?
sources.said: Extension of Stay must be sought from the Immigration Department and recorded in the passport. ... Statement of financial position from a reputable banker from the applicant or person accepting responsibility for the applicant. ... Non-CARICOM Nationals: EC$800.00 ... Extension of Stay from Immigration Department is required during the period that application is being processed.
